summary: The class-table resets BSP_Game_LoadMissionScene runs at 004E0AA0..004E0ACD and BSP_EngineMovie_Stop at 0045F6C6..0045F6F8 ("<Table>=nil\n" through 006B8AD0 on the mission Lua machine, right after luaPrecacheUnits and the 0095CA70 VehicleClass purge). No game run was made; the OFF build (switch false) also built and passed.
